reviewTitle: Perfect tracking for my luggage and keys!
reviewDescription: I bought these to help me keep track of my luggage and daily keys, and they have been an absolute lifesaver. The setup process with my iPhone was incredibly simple and only took a few seconds per tracker. The precision finding feature is unbelievably accurate. It guides me right to my keys every single morning when I am rushing to get out the door. I drop my keys on the driveway constantly, and even after taking a few hard hits, the trackers still function perfectly without any connectivity issues. They also provide immense peace of mind when I am traveling. Being able to open the app and see exactly where my checked bags are located takes all the stress out of flying. The battery life is fantastic and the fact that you can easily replace the standard coin battery yourself is a huge bonus. Paired with the black shockproof cases I recently purchased, these are the most reliable tracking devices on the market. I highly recommend picking up a pack if you want to stop losing your everyday essentials.

reviewDescription: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ This is such a great product to have. ❌‼️NOTE: THERE HAS TO BE IPHONES AROUND THE AIR TAG FOR IT TO BE TRACKABLE!! So even if it’s around other strangers IPhones you can still pick up on where it is. However if it happens to be somewhere where there are no iPhones around, you will no longer be able to find it until it is in close range of other iPhones again. That’s one down side however with the population and use of so many iPhones I don’t see that being a problem unless I’m in a rural area or far in the country or something. 🤷♀️ 🐾 🐶 This fact alone is why some say it’s not the best GPS device to use for tracking your pets. There are GPS devices that work no matter where they are but usually you have to pay a subscription fee so to me this is still better then having no tracker on my dog. I have one inside of my wallet & purse too & one of my favorite features is how I can have it ALERT ME if I walk away from my purse/wallet. So if I leave it in the car or at a friend’s or in a store, I will get a text right away as I’m walking away from it. That alone has helped me already. I’m very happy to have this. I got a card holder to put mine in so it would easily go into my wallet. This air tag is durable and feels nice. They sell waterproof protector cases incase you want to make sure your air tag is protected. I’m going to do that to some of mine but the one in my wallet can’t be done like that because it would become too thick. ✅SUPER EASY TO SET UP- as soon as I pulled the tab off the AirTag for it to start working my phone picked up on it and asked if I wanted to connect. I didn’t even have to do anything. So easy. This is great security and gives me peace of mind. ✅This is a very versatile product as it can be used for SO MANY different things. 👍PETS 👍CARS 👍PURSES 👍WALLETS 👍SHOE INSOLES (they sell ones that have spots for an air tag so you can track your CHILD or elderly family member. ❤️ 👍BACKPACK 👍LUGGAGE 👍 PACKAGE 👍 ELECTRIC SCOOTER OR BIKE 👍 SAFE/LOCK BOX 👍 ELECTRONICS (they make cases to fit certain electronics so you can put an air tag on them. 👍 CAR KEYS 👍 CLOTHING (for child or people) AND MORE!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️HIGHLY RECOMMEND⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I have had NO issues with tracking or finding. It has been accurate for me and has alerted me every time I walk away. I am impressed and very happy. I just bought an off brand tracking device that came with 4 bulkier products and it works with (find my iphone) just like air tags so I’m curious to see how those work because I got 4 for cheaper than this air tag. I’m going to use them for my luggage on my upcoming trip. Hopefully they work just as well. 🤷♀️

reviewTitle: Perfect for Keeping Track of Pets & Everyday Items
reviewDescription: This AirTag has honestly been amazing. It is super easy to set up and incredibly accurate when trying to locate things. In my case, I use it to help keep track of one of my cats who likes to decide when she does and does not want to come when called. She can be extremely selective about answering me, so this has been a huge help. What I love most is how it guides you as you get closer. Instead of just giving a vague location, it actually helps point you right toward where the AirTag is, which makes finding her so much easier and less stressful. The sound feature is also very helpful when she’s hiding somewhere unexpected in the house. The battery life has been great and the tracking updates quickly and accurately. Definitely one of those Apple products that just works exactly the way it should. Highly recommend for pets, keys, wallets, or anything important you tend to misplace.
